Relic remembers everything you copy, understands it on-device, and syncs it across your phones and computers, sealed so only you can read it. Save things you want to find more easily later, and bring them up with a hotkey without leaving your keyboard. Works with files, images, text snippets, and anything that might not have a home in your setup.

# RelicAlternatives

Exploring Relic alternatives? Try Paste for polished, cross-device clipboard history, or the lean, open-source Maccy for speed. Note-takers may prefer Reflect with networked ideas. For power users, CopyCat Clipboard adds smart actions, while Pasta works like a time machine for anything you’ve copied.
